notes.title: ​​Desktop Pet Update & Bundle with Spy Thriller Visual Novel "Insects Awaken"
notes.content:
​​Hello everyone, thank you for your patience!​​

[h3]While True Desktop Pet Content Update Preview[/h3]

Our fluffy black cat companion is getting an upgrade! More interactive gameplay and surprise easter eggs are on the way—stay tuned!

Additionally, we've partnered with the recently released game Insects Awaken to offer a special ​​bundle​​. Purchasing the bundle grants you a ​​10% discount​​. If you already own one of the games, you can complete the bundle at a discounted price. Unfortunately, Insects Awaken is not yet available in English, but if you're interested, we'd appreciate your wishlist support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/721019542475535dbcc153d130d69583bb2c6a60.jpg[/img]

[h3]About Insects Awaken[/h3]

In Insects Awaken, players navigate between the isolated cities of Shanghai and Chongqing, using a unique map system to participate in—or observe—thrilling events that drive the story forward day by day. Will you play as a double agent, skillfully maneuvering between rival factions? Or will you rely on your wits to complete seemingly impossible espionage missions? Every choice you make, every action you take, could be the key to turning the tide of history.

Featuring ​​over 400,000 words of non-repetitive dialogue​​ and ​​4 distinct endings​​, a single playthrough is estimated to take ​​10-15 hours​​.

If you enjoyed the ​​mind-bending deduction and multi-layered storytelling​​ of CyberManhunt, you'll find a similarly deep experience in Insects Awaken—except this time, the stage shifts from a cyberpunk future to the ​​war-torn battlegrounds of the Anti War era​​.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53835/_/

Thank you for your support! For more updates, follow us on social media. 🚀

notes.title: Chapter 5 Out Now — Cyber Manhunt 2: New World is Complete!
notes.content:
[h3]Chapter 5 of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] is officially out! With that, we are out of the early access phase and now a full release! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=IXz7CayhVKw;full][/previewyoutube]
With the Chapter 5 update, the [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] story has come to an end. To all players who have been waiting for this finale, we thank you for your patience and support, and we hope this chapter is satisfying for everyone.  

[b]We have also left an easter egg in Chapter 5... And players who have been closely observing our studio may have noticed a little hint that we left at the start of this year on Apple and Google App Stores. [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/7f13ce347b2cfad03252b5ae2ea2f2b319785e19.png[/img]

We are delighted to have this opportunity to live the dream of becoming a game developer. Although there are some differences from the previous installment of Cyber Manhunt, we believe that its core is the same - that is, despite the set-up of a world full of bad people, the idea of love and goodwill is conveyed to everyone. 

The "Cyber Manhunt" series started in 2021 and it has been 4 whole years since then.

[b] We at the studio have been continuously growing: polishing the graphics, optimizing the gameplay, upgrading the UI, getting better at integrating social engineering into the game... And we have you, the players, to thank for being steadfast by our side.[/b]

At offline game exhibitions and events, we frequently meet players who come by to chat with us, and it always warms our heart to see you, and we become even more determined to get this game right.

The game touched many topics — online safety, information privacy, school bullying, loan sharks... We hope that through the "Cyber Manhunt" series, our players become better informed and we are able to help build a better and safer internet and world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/192d7f04dca688f8b4e1563ccb2a650f6a46a06d.jpg[/img]

[b] Even if the impact may be small, but we believe that as long as a single player has gained something from this game, then our efforts would not be for nothing.

[/b] As we carry this hope with us, we shall continue to work hard to send our message to the world. Regardless, we take pride in what we have made, and with the final chapter of this game, we can finally let out a small breath and give ourselves a pat on the back and a break.

Compared to the previous "Cyber Manhunt", this game has much more gameplay, drama, performance and voice acting. Hence, the cost of production has greatly increased and we are unable to keep the game price of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] the same as four years ago. [b]After the launch period discount, we will have to increase the price of the game from USD 9.99 to USD 12.99 (and other regions will have a corresponding increase as well) so we hope you understand that this decision was not an easy one to make. [/b]

[h3]However, after our brief break, we will continue to update some extra content for free:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] game soundtrack will be made available to everyone for free
[*] Based on player feedback, we will continue to polish our free desktop pet DLC "Van's Partner in Crime" and add more functions to it 
[/olist]

[b]Once again, I would like to thank all players for the continuous love and support and you will enjoy the content above[/b]

Last but not least, we have joined up with another sci-fi story-driven game, Minds Beneath Us, which has an "Overwhelmingly Positive" review on Steam , to create a wonderful bundle just for the sci-fi lover in you! Get an extra 12% off when you purchase our games through the "Cyber Minds" bundle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/736e252f728272ef2fe2b11efa1762c405b4456e.jpg[/img]

Cyber Detective, the New World is upon us, will you rise to meet it?

notes.title: Official Release of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World on 21 Jan
notes.content:
Greetings Cyber Detectives!

We have wonderful news to share with everyone! Our efforts have finally paid off and Chapter 5 will be ready for decoding on 21st January!

With the release of the final chapter of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i], we will graduate from Early Access and officially become a Full Release game! To celebrate this major milestone, we will have an [b]all-time-best discount of 12% off, making it only USD 8.79 for two weeks[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_2_New_World__The_Hacking_Simulator/

For players of the first [i]Cyber Manhunt[/i], an even better deal of USD 7.47 awaits you when you purchase the game through the [b]Cyber Manhunt bundle[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40936/Cyber_Manhunt_Complete_Saga/

Please note that after the discount period, the game's price will increase from USD 9.99 to USD 12.99 so make sure not to miss your chance to purchase it in the first two weeks of our official launch!

We are so grateful to all players who have been supporting us throughout the Early Access period, and we cannot wait to share the fruits of our labor with you on 21st January!

[h3]If we have no freedom or choice, can we even call ourselves "humans"?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=UT8iqe0H57g;full][/previewyoutube]

In the first four chapters, we bore witness to cyberbullying, loan sharks, human trafficking and other controversial social issues, and followed the trail of crimes into the mastermind's dangerous nest — and it is deeper and darker than you might think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/fbba8a08c99bb84b1a60b12239fb9c60ae1ac95f.png[/img]

As we approach the final chapter, a new urgent mission becomes the spark that brings the truth to light — and it all starts with monitoring a Senior R&D Engineer Nathan Richter to investigate and eliminate all uncontrollable risk factors associated with him.

Why would someone with a fulfilling personal and professional life like Nathan Richter suddenly disappear without a trace? Is his mysterious disappearance linked to chip implanted in his brain? Once again, your intellect and social engineering is put to the test as you uncover the manipulation and resistance hidden behind the social order.

[b]Get ready for the final chapter on 21 January 2025![/b]

notes.title: New Update: Free Desktop Pet DLC Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Detectives!

Chapter 5 is currently under rapid development, but before its release, we’d like to offer you a little appetizer to enjoy in the meantime. We hope you Cyber Detectives will love it—

[h2]Van's Partner in Crime - Free Desktop Pet DLC Update[/h2]
Remember the adorable cat from Chapter 4? Ever since it made its debut, we've been inundated with requests for a desktop pet version.
Well, it's finally here! Enter the game and enjoy some cyber kitty companionship—just be careful not to stare at it too long, or time might slip away unnoticed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/0827df9abc5346e7cbe6095034ea5f40275a618b.gif[/img]

Since the desktop pet wasn’t part of our original plan, and we had to develop it without delaying Chapter 5, only the basic features have been implemented for now (but it’s still functional and fun!).

In fact, once the desktop pet was confirmed for production, the team got quite excited and brainstormed many small features to include. [b]After Chapter 5 is completed, and if time permits, we’ll continue to improve its functionality. Please feel free to share your ideas with us—we greatly appreciate your feedback![/b]

After updating the game, you can access the desktop pet page in-game and summon While True (tears of the programmer) to keep you company!
[u]P.S.: Due to system limitations on Mac, some features are restricted. For a better desktop pet experience, we recommend that Mac players use windowed mode.[/u]

In addition, both Cyber Manhunt 2 and The Operator will soon have individual discounts on their base games, so be sure to keep an eye out for those prices as well!

⚔️ Wandering Sword (Historic Lowest 15% OFF!)– Martial Arts RPG

notes.title: Major Update: Chapter 4 Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey Cyber Detectives! 

We’re thrilled to announce that the Chapter 4 major content update that you’ve been eagerly waiting for is finally here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_2_New_World__The_Hacking_Simulator/

To celebrate this major update, we’re offering a special 10% discount on the game, so don’t miss this perfect opportunity to experience an intense cyber detective adventure at a fantastic price!

[h3]Chapter 4 Story Overview[/h3]

Picking up right where Chapter 3 left off, the tables have turned. You, now a liberated AI detective, have broken free from Titan’s imposing grip. Teaming up with Van, the mysterious hacker that returned at the climax of Chapter 3, you face a critical question: can he truly be trusted, or is this another layer of deception? Time will unravel these tangled threads.

[h3]A New Challenge: The Case of CαThγ [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/5955eb7567aa75ec932c5dfc4e777dd4e5acd94d.jpg[/img]
Your main task in this chapter is to investigate CαThγ, an AI digital life streamer spiraling out of control. Originally, CαThγ was created to represent Cathy Wharton, a 14-year-old celebrity forced to step back from the public eye due to a tragic accident. Titan has dramatically reintroduced her to the world using advanced AI technology, but behind her renewed persona lurks a dark and murky tale. This investigation takes a sudden turn when Cathy's live stream is abruptly terminated after she mentions "Paradise Isle”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/7d2df87375a504a3a8f1618dcaf663e650291663.gif[/img]

What secrets does this elusive place harbor? Are the swirling rumors about its high-profile visitors – from famous actors to prominent politicians – true? It's up to you to crack the code, connect the dots, and expose the hidden agendas lurking within the upper echelons of society. The balance of justice and corruption rests squarely in your hands.

[h3]New Hacking Tactics In Chapter 4[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/77b86f2d2cd5656f20ec4a49c9157c0940bab162.gif[/img]
Chapter 4 not only continues the engaging and tense social engineering and hacking simulation but also expands your toolkit with a variety of new hacking tactics. Get ready to penetrate classified government systems, crack encrypted satellite communications, and hack into the digital vaults of an online casino, among other challenges. Prepare to dive deeper into the thrilling world of cyber investigation!

As always, we welcome your valuable feedback and suggestions as we continue to improve and optimize the game to provide a better gaming experience for everyone.

In addition, we’d be grateful if you could help us spread the word and share your excitement with your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_2_New_World__The_Hacking_Simulator/

And a head’s up: The Dystopian Detectives Double Feature Bundle — in collaboration with Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You is now available for purchase, grab your bundle now and enjoy extra savings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/d39a750235ce20e5e5311c9a77a077e3a3dd2844.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support, and we hope you enjoy this new storyline!

notes.title: We've Just Rolled Out A New Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, Cyber Detectives!

It's been a week since our launch, and we want to take a moment to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for your support and enthusiasm. We’re thrilled to see so many of you diving into the mysteries and intricacies Cyber Manhunt 2: New World. We've received some incredible feedback and suggestions from you, and we're excited to share some updates and optimizations that will enhance your gaming experience!

Without further ado, let's dive into the patch notes:

[h2]Unlocking Your Demo Achievements[/h2]
For those of you who played our demo previously, we’ve rolled out a fix that will automatically unlock your demo achievements in the full game.

First off, download this achievement file [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uL9gVvGWcsDql3Ahh2702RoAKvOt0prt/view?usp=sharing]here[/url]

Depending on your operating system, follow the respective steps below:

[b]Windows:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Navigate to the path: C:\Users\[Your Computer Username]\AppData\LocalLow\ALUBA\CyberManhunt2
[*] Copy and paste the file into the above path.
[*] Open the game.
[/olist][b]Mac:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Navigate to the path: /Library/Application Support/com.aluba.CyberManhunt2
[*] Copy and paste the file into the above path.
[*] Open the game.
[/olist]
This will unlock all achievements in the demo version.

[h2]Features Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized the problem that demo achievements can't be inherited directly.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty and part of the text of Chapter 3 Opinion Play, modified part of the entertainment news to livelihood news, and lowered the settlement difficulty.
[*] Optimized the AI dubbing of the third chapter of the trial, and added two new voice lines for players to choose from.
[*] Adjusted the warning text at the beginning of the game, and added meta play live warning.
[*] Added a confirmation pop-up window for “continue the game or not” after the end of the chapter.
[*] Optimized the unlock conditions and tips for the phone invasion in the prologue.
[*] Optimized the reasoning in the prologue and the first chapter.
[*] Optimized the AI search function in Chapter 3, which will be enabled after the end of Reasoning II.
[*] Optimized the new email alerts to not disappear automatically.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed While True not displaying in 32:9 resolution.
[*] Fixed the issue that the time in the phone is displayed incorrectly when hacking the phone.
[*] Fixed some error messages in AI searching.
[*] Fixed some date and text errors.
[*] Fixed the bug that the BGM will be reset automatically when the plot progresses.
[*] Fixed bug with icon hints for some entries.
[*] Fixed Thomas's phone call error in Chapter 1.
[*] Fixed a bug in the date of death of Iris in the deduction animation of Chapter 1.
[*] Fixed Oracle text error in Chapter 3.
[*] Fixed clicking restart in Opinion gameplay in Chapter 3 resulting in a stuck-level issue.
[/list] 
We're grateful for your ongoing support and would love to keep hearing from you. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable as we continue to refine and enhance the game. If you enjoy the game, we’d really appreciate it if you could share it with your friends and family, as we believe Cyber Manhunt is not just a game but also a way to spread online awareness to everyone. 

If you haven't experienced our game yet, visit our store page and check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_2_New_World/

Additionally, if you haven't already, be sure to follow our Steam and Twitter pages for upcoming updates. This is just the start of our adventure, and we can’t wait for you to step into the role of a cyber detective and unravel the interconnected mysteries that await!

notes.title: Preparing for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Enthusiasts!

Happy new year! As we step into the new year, we would like to share some quick updates regarding the limited-time demo. First and foremost, a massive thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and suggestions on it - your insights are incredibly valuable to us!

As you delve into the intriguing world of hacking and AI, we hope that the intricate puzzles and immersive storytelling have captured your imagination. Were you able to piece together all the clues and secrets hidden within the first chapter? We’re eager to hear about your experiences, so feel free to share your thoughts in the comments!

[h2]Prepping for Steam Next Fest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/1a10fc382a24195a9181db72dd5f6ffbf2dfcfd9.jpg[/img]

In preparation for our participation in Steam Next Fest in February 2024, we've temporarily taken down the demo. But fear not – this is to make way for something even more exhilarating. Get ready for a new and improved demo, packed with fresh content that will plunge you deeper into a gripping conspiracy! You'll find yourself at the center of an intricate web of mystery and intrigue, where each decision could lead to groundbreaking discoveries or throw you off the trail. We’re all hands on deck to make this an even better gaming experience, and we can’t wait to share it with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/2035c7388367e4583087a9b7603699564fbcfcaf.jpg[/img]
As Steam Next Fest approaches, we'll keep you updated with more news and sneak peeks. To ensure you don't miss any announcements, do add Cyber Manhunt: New World to your Steam wishlist. This way, you'll also get instant notifications when our new demo becomes available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_New_World/

Last but not least, we would like to express our gratitude to you for being part of our journey. The truth is out there, waiting to be uncovered, and you are an integral part of this adventure!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optimizations Update!
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Enthusiasts!

We hope that you have enjoyed playing the Cyber Manhunt: New World demo so far! We have received loads of great feedback from everyone and we truly appreciate all your efforts. As such, we would like to share that we made some quick bug fixes and optimization updates related to the main story. 

Here's what's new in this update:

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where missing scripts for anonymous calls led to a game freeze
[*] Fixed an issue causing an unexpected game exit during the prologue’s browser tutorial, preventing game progress
[*] Fixed an issue where random inputs during the prologue’s browser tutorial resulted in a game freeze
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1 where Ashley's name was not appearing in post-deduction dialogue
[*] Fixed a game-freezing bug caused by not ending the anonymous call before the deduction scene in Chapter 1
[/list][h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the wording in the email containing the Finder verification code
[*] Decreased the AI's search frequency for the Finder verification code
[*] Extended the invasion duration in the prologue from 3 minutes to 3 minutes and 30 seconds
[*] Implemented an auto-stop feature for ongoing Hitalk voice playback when switching or closing chat windows in Hitalk
[*] Optimized certain in-game dialogue for clarity
[/list]
If during the playtest you encounter any bugs or translation issues please feel free to submit us a bug report at: https://forms.gle/CEcJ5QWJ1VYEWrsJ7

notes.title: Welcome to Cyber Manhunt: New World!
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Enthusiasts!

We’re the developers behind the award-winning Cyber Manhunt, a gripping cyber-hacking narrative puzzle game. Today, we are excited to bring to you the much-anticipated sequel to it — [b]Cyber Manhunt: New World! [/b]

[h2]Our Gripping Announcement Trailer![/h2]
[previewyoutube=RVMGl3zyoCc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What’s more, a free demo for the game is now available for you to play on Steam.[/b] For those of you who ventured deep into the enigmatic corridors of Cyber Manhunt, you know the thrill of unraveling the dark corners of the digital world. And if you're new to the game, fret not, you're in for an experience that's both captivating and thought-provoking!

[h2]About The Game[/h2]
Set against a backdrop reminiscent of its predecessor, Cyber Manhunt: New World immerses you in an engrossing cyber hacking narrative that resonates with the challenges of today's digital society. Play as an AI in a major corporation and navigate profound real-world challenges centered on big data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. Deploy an arsenal of intricate social engineering tactics to decipher concealed mysteries - while delving in tales shrouded in ambition and intrigue.

[h3]Real-World Inspired Storylines[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/3256e36a644ec18819668720003014544342772c.gif[/img]
Immerse yourself in an authentic virtual environment where you take on the role of an AI assistant and execute elaborate social engineering assignments inspired from actual hacking incidents.

[h3]Advanced Hacking Techniques[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/1c27e55cc1315f838632d7760024dfa05d66ec3e.gif[/img]
 From foundational methods like password cracking and phishing to more sophisticated techniques such as voice manipulation and server penetration, Experience and utilize authentic hacking strategies as you progress through the complexities of the stories.

[h3]A Spectrum of Lives[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/883654aa04e85d3e6b2c62f23d5233278d14a0f5.png[/img]
Engage with a rich tapestry of characters from various socio-cultural backgrounds. In a world ruled by AI dominance, each character has a story to tell, secrets to reveal, and motivations to understand.

[h3]Engrossing, Interconnected Narrative[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/2035c7388367e4583087a9b7603699564fbcfcaf.jpg[/img]
Every chapter, deeply rooted in real-life events, tells a unique story while contributing to a larger narrative tapestry. Delve deep into the emotional turmoil and psychological struggles of each character, influencing the narrative with your decisions.

But don't just take our word for it. Dive into the free demo now and unravel the mysteries of a world where ambition meets deception, and AI intersects with humanity. 

Building on the experience and lessons learned from the first game, we've optimized various aspects such as game interactions, processes, and visual design to deliver an even more immersive and engaging experience. Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue to refine and enhance the game, and we look forward to your insights about the demo!

Last but not the least, if Cyber Manhunt: New World resonates with you, don’t forget to add it to your Steam wishlist. Spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/Cyber_Manhunt_New_World/

And if you haven’t already, be sure to follow us on Steam and Twitter to be notified of any new updates!
We are currently running an [url=https://twitter.com/cyber_manhunt/status/1724392552940658780]exclusive Steam gift cards giveaway[/url] on Twitter now too, so be sure not to miss it. 

In the meantime, we hope you will enjoy the game!
